about.title: How it works
about.lead: Every answer DhanSaathi gives comes out of arithmetic, not an AI's opinion. Here is the whole path.
about.step1.title: 1. Your transactions
about.step1.body: 18 months of income, spending, EMIs and savings — the only raw material. Age, gender, religion, caste and address never enter a model.
about.step2.title: 2. 33 features
about.step2.body: How steady income is, how much spending swings, loan load, savings, trends — recomputed fresh every time.
about.step3.title: 3. Three models
about.step3.body: A 1,000-path Monte Carlo cash-flow projection, a Cox survival model for when a crunch could come, and an anomaly detector (rules + isolation forest).
about.step4.title: 4. 41 options, one score
about.step4.body: Every product-and-amount pair gets a benefit score from −1 to +1. 'Do nothing' sits at 0 and is a real contender — a product has to beat it.
about.step5.title: 5. The safety gate
about.step5.body: Nine hard rules no model can override. That code cannot even import a machine-learning library — a test enforces it.
about.step6.title: 6. Real banks, real rate bands
about.step6.body: The surviving product is matched to real banks' published rates, and each bank option is re-checked through the gate independently.
about.step7.title: 7. Every decision recorded
about.step7.body: What was decided, by which module, on which inputs — all logged. Same inputs, same decision.
about.honest.title: What we don't do
about.honest.1: No number on screen is computed in the browser — every figure comes from the server.
about.honest.2: The AI (LLM) makes no decisions and can't change a number; right now it's switched off because your data doesn't leave the server.
about.honest.3: Bank rates follow published bands, not live quotes — and it says so wherever a rate appears.
about.honest.4: Consent is real: turn a permission off and the features genuinely stop.
